rewards: Access to Nardok's Bone Weapon Store

st.t: Talk to Sigmund on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
s: Do you have any quests for me?

st.t: In Lumbridge, ask the Cook, Father Aereck and Bob "Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?" and Hans "Do you know what happened in the cellar?" Stop when one of them tells you about seeing a goblin.
Talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle. Choose the line that names the person who told you about the goblin, such as "The cook says he saw something in the cellar".
Use a pickaxe on the rubble in the Lumbridge Castle basement.
Enter the hole in Lumbridge Castle's basement.
With your light source lit, pick up the brooch on the cave floor, about 10 steps south-east of the hole. Then go straight back to the cellar, as walking further can drop you into a pit.
Show the brooch to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle Library and show him the brooch. Then search the north west bookcase, the northern one on the west wall, for the goblin symbol book.
Read the entire goblin symbol book.
Talk to the Goblin Generals in the Goblin Village.
s: Have you ever heard of the Dorgeshuun?
Well either way they refused to fight
Well I found a brooch underground...
Well why not show me both greetings?

st.t: With a lit light source, go through the hole in the Lumbridge Castle basement and follow the tunnels east to Mistag. Stay on the safe path: a wrong turn drops you in a hole and puts your light out. Goblin symbols on the rocks show the way: Rekeshuun means north, Idithuun south, Ekeleshuun east and Narogoshuun west. Tapping ahead on the minimap also follows the safe path.
Perform the Goblin Bow emote next to Mistag and talk to him.
Talk to Mistag to fast-travel back to Lumbridge. Then talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
s: Can you show me the way out of the mines?
I've made contact with the cave goblins...

st.t: Pickpocket Sigmund for a key. He's on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
Open the chest in the room next to the Duke's room.
Go to the H.A.M. hideout's trapdoor, north-west of Lumbridge Castle, and pick its lock. It may take a few tries. You don't need a lockpick, but one helps if your Thieving is low.
Climb down the trapdoor and search the crate just south of the ladder for the silverware.
Take the silverware to Duke Horacio.
s: I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!

st.t: Go through the hole in the Lumbridge Castle basement and talk to Kazgar to travel to Mistag. Then talk to Mistag with the peace treaty in your inventory.
s: Can you show me the way to the mines?
